# E14: Zero Waste

**Display ID:** E14  
**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** No  
**Category:** Circular Design and Waste Reduction  
**Applicability:** Project  
**Project types:** Print, Hybrid, Packaging, Signage, Exhibit  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 11, SDG 12, SDG 14, SDG 15

## Summary
Eliminates waste.

## Criteria
The final product is a "zero waste" product.

## Why it matters
Zero waste products.

## Extended guidance
Zero Waste certifications are available for both projects and entities. For example, [TRUE certification](https://true.gbci.org/true-certification-zero-waste) and the [SCS Zero Waste](https://www.scsglobalservices.com/services/zero-waste-certification) program.
